summary: Multi-prong correction: historical proven traffic repair plus exact historical test, alongside already-created new traffic phrase test.

actions.reason: Historical and current proven row should be protected as part of the multi-prong repair. This is not the whole answer; it restores bid support for the only current converting keyword while new traffic is tested separately.
evidence: Current 2026-04-22..2026-05-21: magnetic car decals 10 clicks / 1 order / ACOS 17.6%.
Previous 2026-03-23..2026-04-21: magnetic car decals 9 clicks / 1 order / ACOS 23.8%.
Operator correction: historical effective traffic and new traffic should both be handled, not either/or.
actions.forceReason: Operator correction clarified multi-prong handling; small reversible bid repair on a current+historical converting row.
actions.hypothesis: Give the current converting historical keyword enough bid support while keeping the increase small and reversible.

expectedEffect.target: increase exposure without letting ACOS exceed historical controlled range

reviewPlan.1d: confirm bid landed and CPC not abnormal
reviewPlan.3d: check clicks/search terms and first conversion signal
reviewPlan.7d: hold only if ACOS/orders remain acceptable; rollback if clicks spend without orders

actions.reason: Historical winners should not only stay in broad. Add a capped EXACT lane for the historical buyer-facing terms that had order proof, so we can separate exact recovery from broad drift.

actions.forceReason: Operator correction clarified historical proven traffic needs active handling; daily budget capped at 1 and bid at 0.11.
